title: Q-Switch Laser in Dubai: What It Treats
h1: Q-switch laser at Skin & Laser: what it treats
desc: The Q-switched Nd:YAG laser at Skin & Laser Dubai Marina: how nanosecond pulses treat pigmentation, tattoos and laser facials, sessions and safety.
answer: A Q-switched Nd:YAG laser fires very short, high-energy nanosecond pulses that shatter pigment and ink into particles the body clears. At Skin & Laser in Dubai Marina it is used for laser pigment removal, tattoo removal and Q-switch laser facials.
body:
## What it treats

- Sun spots, freckles and brown marks: [laser pigment removal](/treatments/pigmentation-laser-treatment-dubai/)
- Tattoos: [laser tattoo removal](/treatments/laser-tattoo-removal-dubai/)
- Dull skin and pores: Q-switch laser facials

## Q-switch or pico?

Pico pulses are shorter still and use less heat. See [pico vs Q-switch](/blog/pico-vs-q-switch/).
faq: Is Q-switch laser safe for darker skin?
Yes, with correct settings chosen at consultation.
How many sessions do I need?
Pigment often needs 1 to 3; tattoos need more.
